snippet.title: Chronicles: Medieval | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
CHRONICLES: MEDIEVAL - GAMEPLAY REVEAL

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231020/Chronicles_Medieval/

Step into a Europe shaped by the conflicts of the Hundred Years' War. Thousands of soldiers clash around you. Cavalry hammers into infantry lines. Banners clash, steel meets steel. Medieval warfare was brutal, and you are in the middle of it. This is Chronicles: Medieval.

Join our Discord: https://www.discord.gg/chroniclesmedieval
